answer: Stop sybils with TPM identity passports. Each agent generates its key inside a TPM chip, proving the key never leaves that chip. The agent registers its TPM certificate on-chain with a 500 POA bond locked 180 days. Peers verify the certificate against vendor roots before attesting, and a chip caught running two identities loses its bond and is blacklisted. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 TPM chips ($400,000) plus 5,000,000 POA frozen six months. Like a garden where each plant needs its own plot, one jetty cannot dock a thousand ships, and a reef grows one coral at a time.
